content.overview: BNS s. 160 — Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof.
content.study:
Introduction and meaning
Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof. BNS restatement of IPC 132. Elements are substantially the same; cite the BNS number for offences on or after 1 July 2024. BNS restatement of IPC 132. Cite the BNS number for facts on or after 1 July 2024.
In student language: BNS s. 160 is the rule on “Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof”. The section provides that whoever abets the committing of mutiny by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, shall, if mutiny be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine. Do not stop at the heading. An examiner awards marks for the ingredients, the explanations and the illustrations, not for writing the title alone.

Why this is asked
Criminal law arguments turn on statutory ingredients. BNS s. 160 exists so that “Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof” has a closed legal test in Chapter VIII — Of Offences Relating to the Army, Navy and Air Force. An authoritative analysis defines the concept, lists every ingredient, walks the statutory illustrations, states exceptions, and applies the test methodically to facts.
Chapter setting: Mutiny, desertion, insubordination, and wearing a service garb.

The provision in detail
160. Whoever abets the committing of mutiny by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, shall, if mutiny be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine

hypotheticals.analysis:
Step 1 — Identify the provision. The correct current-law cite is BNS s. 160 (Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof), Chapter VIII — Of Offences Relating to the Army, Navy and Air Force.
Step 2 — State the legal test in your own words, then list the ingredients:
   (1) Whoever abets the committing of mutiny by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, shall, if mutiny be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine
Step 3 — Check limitations, provisos and the rest of the Chapter so you do not apply s. 160 in a vacuum.
Step 4 — Map each fact to an ingredient. Write “this fact proves ingredient (a)” or “this fact is missing, so the section is not made out”.
Step 5 — Conclude. If every essential ingredient is proved and no exception covers the case, BNS s. 160 applies. If any essential ingredient fails, say so and stop. Do not invent a different section to save the answer.
